tools.name: compare_ai_models
tools.description: Return a BenchLM side-by-side comparison summary for two AI models, then open the comparison page in the current tab. Use this when a user wants benchmark, pricing, context window, or capability tradeoffs between models.

modelA.description: First model name, alias, or slug.

modelB.description: Second model name, alias, or slug.

tools.name: estimate_ai_cost
tools.description: Estimate monthly, daily, and yearly AI model cost for real workloads such as blog posts, website pages, docs articles, PRDs/specs, or shipped product features.

unitsPerMonth.description: Number of workload units per month, such as posts, pages, articles, specs, or features.

wordsPerUnit.description: Approximate final words per unit. Ignored for features-shipped.

revisionRounds.description: Number of drafting/revision passes per unit.

modelNames.description: Optional model names to price. Defaults to BenchLM cost-calculator defaults.

tools.name: find_best_models
tools.description: Return top BenchLM-ranked AI models for a use case such as coding, reasoning, tool use, web research, computer use, long context, document AI, image understanding, factuality, open source, or value.

useCase.description: The use case or leaderboard to optimize for. Examples: coding, long context, tool use, web research, open source, value.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return. Defaults to 5.

openWeight.description: If true, only return open-weight models.

maxOutputPrice.description: Optional maximum output price per 1M tokens.

minContextTokens.description: Optional minimum context window in tokens.

reasoning.description: Optional. true returns reasoning models only; false returns non-reasoning models only.

tools.name: get_model_details
tools.description: Return BenchLM metadata for one AI model, including provider, score, source type, context window, reasoning mode, pricing, speed, and category scores.

model.description: The model name, alias, or slug. Examples: GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3 Pro.

tools.name: lookup_benchmark_results
tools.description: Return the BenchLM leaderboard for a specific benchmark, such as SWE-bench Verified, LiveCodeBench, MMLU, GPQA, BFCL, BrowseComp, OSWorld, or AIME.

benchmark.description: Benchmark name, full name, or slug.

limit.description: Maximum number of model results to return. Defaults to 10.

includeUnverified.description: If true, include non-displayable or unverified benchmark rows. Defaults to false.

tools.name: open_benchlm_page
tools.description: Navigate the current BenchLM tab to the best matching page for a model, benchmark, provider, ranking, comparison, blog post, or tool query.

query.description: A natural language page request, exact title, model name, benchmark name, provider name, or BenchLM path.

type.description: Optional result type to prefer when resolving the page.

tools.name: open_model_profile
tools.description: Navigate to the BenchLM profile page for a specific AI model by model name, alias, or slug.

model.description: The model name, alias, or slug. Examples: GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3 Pro.

tools.name: recommend_llm
tools.description: Recommend AI models using BenchLM selector logic for a user use case, budget, context-window need, open-weight preference, and speed/quality preference.

task.description: Optional exact task; overrides the broad use case.

budget.description: For builders, low means at most $5 and mid at most $20 for 1M input + 200k output tokens. free requests open-weight/local candidates, not free hosting.

context.description: Context requirement. large means 200K+ tokens; huge means 1M+ tokens.

openWeight.description: Whether the user needs an open-weight model.

speed.description: Preference for speed versus best quality.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: search_benchlm
tools.description: Search BenchLM for AI models, benchmarks, rankings, comparisons, tools, providers, and blog posts. Use this before navigating when the exact BenchLM page is unknown.

query.description: The model, benchmark, provider, comparison, tool, ranking, or topic to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 8.

tools.name: subscribe_to_benchlm_updates
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to weekly BenchLM benchmark, ranking, and pricing updates. This tool always asks the user to confirm before submitting.
